diagnostics.message: aws_cloudtrail.main should wait for the CloudTrail bucket policy to be attached before creating the trail; referencing the bucket alone does not establish that permission ordering.
module.eventbridge should wait for aws_sns_topic_policy.security_alerts so the EventBridge rules and SNS targets are not activated before the topic grants EventBridge permission to publish.
module.eks should wait for aws_ebs_encryption_by_default.default before provisioning node-group instances, so their EBS volumes are created after the account's default-encryption setting is enabled.

module.pritunl should wait for aws_ebs_encryption_by_default.default before its Auto Scaling Group launches instances, so their EBS volumes are created after the account's default-encryption setting is enabled.
